estimates.anchor_source: No tradable market (Polymarket/Kalshi fetched 2026-09-17T03:41:48Z). Nearest sibling object: C05 log P(any quantification of the bundle at 5 Nov) = 0.27; the base rate and decomposition here are built from the new-business disclosure history, not from C05.
estimates.conventions: letters, calls, 3Q26 10-Q, FY26 10-K only if filed by the print date; share must be of total Nights and Seats Booked or total GBV (city-level excluded); 'single-digit'/'low-single-digit' = No, 'mid-single-digit'/'high-single-digit'/'approximately 3%'/'over 3%' = Yes; FY27 revenue figure must be a company statement >= $500M for 2027 (multi-year opportunity statements excluded)

model.structure: hotel-share disclosure hazards 0.12 (5 Nov) and 0.18 (Feb) -> P(disclosed) 0.278 x P(figure >= 3) 0.65 = 0.181; other routes (seats 0.02, GBV 0.02, FY27 revenue 0.03, combined sentence 0.03) 0.096; union 0.260; final 0.25

impact.note: Immaterial. A disclosure does not change the business: hotel and seats volumes are already inside reported nights, their ADR dilution (-0.5pp) and take-rate incentives are in the team path, and Experiences/Services cost sits in field ops. Stock +$2 as a narrative re-rating (a 3-5% share growing ~30% reads as ~1pt of structural growth), haircut because the same disclosure shows homes growing ~1pt slower than reported nights and makes the mix drag explicit. The memo can drop it or fold it into the ADR paragraph.
